## A calculation

```{r}
measurements <- c(4, 7, 9)
mean_measurement <- mean(measurements)
```

The mean measurement is `r round(mean_measurement, 1)`.

## A figure

```{r}
plot(
  x = 1:3,
  y = measurements,
  xlab = "Observation",
  ylab = "Measurement",
  pch = 19
)
```

## Git check

```{r}
git_path <- Sys.which("git")

if (nzchar(git_path)) {
  system2(git_path, "--version", stdout = TRUE)
} else {
  "GIT NOT FOUND — restart RStudio after installing Git, then render again."
}
```
